source.title: How to Design a Simple Multi-Timeframe Trend Strategy on Bitcoin

hypothesis: Hourly bullish MACD crossovers conditioned on a completed-daily bullish MACD regime identify higher-quality BTC trends; holding until the first completed negative hourly candle captures more trend persistence than one-bar exits.
implementation: Spot-executable long/cash using Binance perpetual OHLC as continuous BTC price proxy; no funding charged.
macd: EMA(12)-EMA(26), signal EMA(9), standard parameters on both daily and hourly closes.
entry: After a completed hourly bar produces bullish H1 MACD crossover, enter at next hourly open only if the most recently completed daily MACD line is above its daily signal line.
exit: Once long, remain long while completed hourly candles close >= open. After first completed negative candle (close < open), exit at next hourly open.
daily_filter_availability: A UTC daily MACD state becomes usable only after that UTC day has completed.
development_gate: net Sharpe >0.70, positive total return, max drawdown <30%
success_gate: OOS net Sharpe >1.0, positive at 2x costs, both 2024 and 2025 non-negative, max drawdown <25%, one-hour extra execution delay Sharpe >0.8
no_tuning: All MACD parameters, timeframe hierarchy and exit logic are source-fixed.
